evidence: ESS-DIVE documents repository scope, search/access services, dataset publication, licences and dataset citation practice. The Stage-1 root URL does not identify a standalone README for the specific East River short-record package.
SCEDC documents event/catalog, phase, waveform and station-metadata access, FDSN/SCEDC web services, client tools and citation requirements.

The Zenodo landing page documents the PINNup method context, identifies the deposit as the relevant dataset, and lists figures-pinnup.zip. No standalone README/install guide was independently verified without opening the archive.
